item.title: Reality Fracture draft primer
item.description: What 800 simulated drafts and 100,000 games say about the format before release. Draft the open lane, since no pair dominates. Play 16 or more creatures and choose to play first. Green commons run deepest, and the Way of the Warlord and Wildspeaker are late-pick gems.
